servers.title: Servers
servers.list.description: Your servers, as their agents report them.
servers.list.empty_description: Add a server and install its agent to see its disk, memory and CPU here.
servers.add.title: Add server
servers.add.description: Name the server; the next page shows the command that installs its agent.
servers.gauge.title: Current values
servers.gauge.legend: Rings: share in use; load: work waiting per core. Colour and a word: the value can alert.
servers.history.empty: No samples in the last 14 days.
servers.install.title: Install the agent
servers.install.description: Run these commands on {{name}}; this page updates when the first report arrives.
servers.install.copy_failed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.
servers.install.verify_summary: Download, verify the checksum, then run
servers.install.source: The script and the agent come from the GitHub release of this Heptapod version, never from this instance:
servers.install.reach: The server must reach this instance over HTTPS.
servers.install.token_gone: The token was shown once, when it was created. Rotate the token to get a new one.
servers.rotate.title: Rotate token
servers.rotate.description: The agent on {{name}} stops reporting at once, until you run the installer there again with the new token.
servers.rotate.done_description: Run the installer again on {{name}}; it asks for this token.
servers.remove.title: Remove server
servers.remove.description: Deletes {{name}} with its samples of the last 14 days. Its agent token stops working at once; uninstall the agent on the server.
servers.install.asks_token: The installer asks for the token at its hidden “Agent token:” prompt.
servers.install.attestation: With the GitHub CLI you can also check the build provenance before running it:
servers.list.legend: Disk and RAM: share in use. Load: against the CPU cores.
servers.list.legend_detail: Share in use; Disk used shows the fullest disk. Grey: fine · orange: near the alert threshold · red: at or above it. The tick marks the threshold. Load is the 5-minute load against the CPU cores; it alerts at {{factor}}× the cores.
servers.gauge.load_detail: Processes running or waiting to run, averaged over 5 minutes. Includes processes waiting for the disk. A value above the number of vCPUs means work is queuing.
servers.install.no_release: No agent release is known for this build ({{version}}) yet; install the agent from a released Heptapod version.
servers.install.latest_release: This build ({{installed}}) has no agent release of its own, so the command installs the agent of {{version}}, the latest release.
servers.list.filtered_description: Clear the filters to see every server.
servers.link.title: Link sites to {{name}}
servers.link.description: Linked sites show this server on their Overview, and this page lists them.
servers.link.suggested_detail: Suggested when a site's DNS points directly at an IP address this server reports and the site is on no other server. A site behind a CDN points at the CDN instead, so it is never suggested.
servers.link.unknown_site: One of these sites does not exist or is not visible to you.
servers.linked.title: Linked sites
servers.linked.description: The sites that run on this server, problem sites first.
servers.linked.empty: No sites linked yet. Link the sites that run on this server.
servers.settings.title: Server settings
servers.settings.description: The name, the mounts to show and the alert thresholds.
servers.settings.thresholds_description: An alert is sent once a value stays at or above its threshold for the duration.
servers.settings.load_hint_one: Alerts at a 5-minute load of {{load}} on this server's {{formattedCount}} vCPU.
servers.settings.load_hint_other: Alerts at a 5-minute load of {{load}} on this server's {{formattedCount}} vCPU.
servers.mounts.title: Mounts
servers.mounts.description: Clear a mount to ignore it: it no longer shows on this page and never alerts. Its data is kept.
servers.site.section_description: The server this site runs on.
servers.site.field_help: The site's Overview shows this server, and the server lists the site. A site runs on one server.
servers.history.thresholds: Dashed lines: each disk's alert threshold
servers.link.loading_failed: The sites could not be loaded. Close the sheet and open it again.
